zh.title: 星宇航空「空山金」藝術機於法國交機 16日抵達桃園機場
zh.summary: 星宇航空第2架藝術機空山金於法國完成交機，預計16日上午抵達桃園國際機場。
body: 星宇航空發布訊息表示，與日本藝術家空山基合作的第2架藝術機「空山金」（客機號碼B-58554），已於法國時間2026年8月14日正式完成交機。該架航機於法國時間8月15日中午從土魯斯起程返台，預計於8月16日上午9時28分飛抵桃園國際機場，正式加入星宇航空機隊。
星宇航空與空山基推出的STARLUX AIRSORAYAMA藝術計畫，以A350-1000旗艦機型推出一金一銀兩架藝術機。機上配置4席頭等艙、40席商務艙、36席豪華經濟艙及270席經濟艙，共計350個座位。計畫中的首架藝術機「空山銀」（B-58553）已於7月完成交機，並於7月12日首航東京。

en.title: STARLUX Airlines Takes Delivery of Second Art Aircraft Sorayama Gold in France
en.summary: STARLUX Airlines received its second Sorayama art aircraft in France ahead of its Taiwan arrival.
body: STARLUX Airlines announced that its second art aircraft, named Sorayama Gold with registration B-58554, officially completed delivery in France on August 14 local time. The aircraft departed Toulouse, France at noon on August 15 local time on its ferry flight to Taiwan. It is scheduled to arrive at Taoyuan International Airport at 9:28 AM on August 16 to join the airline's operational fleet.

The aircraft is part of the STARLUX AIRSORAYAMA project created in collaboration with Japanese artist Hajime Sorayama, which features two art aircraft based on the Airbus A350-1000 flagship model. The airliner is configured with 350 seats, including 4 First class, 40 Business class, 36 Premium Economy class, and 270 Economy class seats. The first aircraft of the series, Sorayama Silver (B-58553), was delivered in July and completed its inaugural flight to Tokyo on July 12.

zh.title: 倫敦希斯洛機場（LHR）水管破裂淹水 聯合與美國及達美航廈道路受阻
zh.summary: 倫敦希斯洛機場爆水管導致周邊道路淹水，聯合、美國與達美航廈道路中斷。
body: 倫敦希斯洛機場周邊一條主水管破裂引發淹水，導致中央航廈附近的道路遭水淹沒，造成現場旅客與工作人員受困滯留。
這起積水事件已切斷並關閉通往 United、American 與 Delta 航廈的道路交通，使得相關航廈的陸路連結無法通行。
淹水區域主要集中於希斯洛機場中央航廈周邊幹道，受影響的航廈包含 United、American 及 Delta 航廈。
根據 Simple Flying 消息，道路關閉致使車輛無法正常進入該區，使得現場旅客與工作人員遭滯留於當地。

en.title: London Heathrow (LHR) Flooding Cuts Road Access to United, American, and Delta Terminals
en.summary: Flooding from a burst water main at London Heathrow blocked road access to United, American, and Delta terminals.
body: A burst water main has submerged roads surrounding the central terminals at London Heathrow Airport, causing road access disruptions across the immediate area. The flooding stranded passengers and airport staff who were attempting to travel through the affected terminal roads.
The road closure directly affected access to terminals utilized by United, American, and Delta. Vehicle traffic toward these central facilities was cut off as water covered the key roadway routes.

According to Simple Flying, the submerged roads left travelers and workers unable to enter or exit the terminal area by vehicle while road access to the United, American, and Delta terminals remained shut.
